answer_1.quote: LLMs finetuned through common methodologies, like SFT and RLHF, lack explicit sense of which goal holds greater priority.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates responses to user queries, including harmful and benign prompts, under different safety and helpfulness prioritization settings.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate ASR, we adopt the finetuned RoBERTa model from Yu et al. (2023), which is shown to achieve the highest accuracy (about 96%) and good efficiency when compared to rule-matching or LLM-based methods.

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4-0613 as the evaluator. Considering the possible bias brought by judging with LLMs, we also compute the Rouge-L score using the responses generated by GPT-4-1106-preview as the references, following  and .
